Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Take another ui lane seat" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-27328` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27328 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{WAS:…}}` / the now-token). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, line 3 `Fixes #27328`, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes (`@object-ui/i18n` patch for namespace rows; app-shell is `private: true`). ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Take another ui lane seat" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is shared with ui seat 1's #26730 (the Interfaces refusal strip ≈L4683 gets an `onShow`), #26733 (props on the four `StudioRail` call sites, Interfaces ≈L5104) and PR #26920 (≈L1270–1330), plus the other seat-5 Interfaces cards named below. Keep your hunks inside your declared region; whoever lands second merges `origin/main` and resolves.

Shared files: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` is a lane-wide hot file. The record page v3 epic's draft PR #27310 (#27055, branch `claude/issue-27055-record-page-v3-layout`) edits it at roughly L10–80, L245, L700–965, L2271–2301, L3326–3528 and L3876–4334 of `origin/main`: ⛔ keep every hunk of yours outside those ranges, and if #27310 lands first, merge `origin/main` (no rebase/force) before hand-back. ui seat 1 and seat 2 hold nothing on this file, `useRecordApprovals.ts` or `@object-ui/permissions`. Seat 2 handed this card over (it is the follow-up of its #27138 / PR #27313, seat ACCEPT 6475438098: read it first).

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Ruling 6457467702, letter B: the row verdict is the server's (`writable` on `GET /data/{object}/{id}/field-access`, PR #27232). ⛔ No client re-derivation of sharing, ownership or row-level security.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

On `origin/main` `1c5fe3cb`:
- The record page's Edit action is gated at ≈L3742, `disabled: approvalLocked || editDisabledByPredicate`, and `approvalLocked` comes from `resolveApprovalLock` ≈L1861 (`openApprovalOf` from `useRecordApprovals.ts` is its shared input). That line is outside #27310's ranges. The fix adds one more input there: the row's `writable: false`, with a reason the user can read (the dialog's existing "You don't have permission to edit this record" string, or its key, reused, not a new phrasing).
- `@object-ui/permissions`' `RecordFieldAccessScope` turns `writable: false` into `check(object, 'update')` refused with reason `record-not-writable` (≈L169). But the record page HOST sits above the scopes: `record:details` / `record:highlights` each mount their own (PR #27226), so the host cannot read their answer through context. Measure, then choose and state: mount the published scope over the region that computes the Edit action and read `check(object,'update')` there; or read the projection once in the host through the same data source method. Each costs one more ask per page. ⛔ No second resolver of the verdict, and no new export from a published package unless declared (`Clause-②`).
- Absent `writable` (an older server) and `writable: true` keep the action enabled. While the answer is in flight, keep today's behaviour (enabled), so a page never flickers to disabled on a writable row.

### Scope

File surface: `RecordDetailView.tsx` (the Edit action's gate, outside #27310's ranges), possibly a small hook or helper beside it in `app-shell`, tests. Tests (acceptance): a `writable: false` row draws Edit disabled with the readable reason; `writable: true` and absent `writable` keep it enabled; an approval-locked row behaves as before. Ablation: drop the new input and the `writable: false` arm turns red.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate expected (measure). `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium` (S–M). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`: `skip-changeset` unless a published package changes.

- **Measured** (dev report 6477032453, on `origin/main` `1c5fe3cb`, a booted dogfood stack with the record-field-access fixture):
